title: Helping Indian Brands Sell to the UAE: Offering Tabby on Razorpay
summary: Sell to UAE shoppers with Tabby on Razorpay. Offer 4 interest-free instalments, settle in INR, and skip overseas incorporation. Auto-enabled for exporters.
body_markdown:
Indian brands selling to the United Arab Emirates often face a steep drop in orders right at the checkout page. In markets like the UAE and Saudi Arabia, around two out of every five online buyers rely on Buy Now, Pay Later services to split purchases into smaller, interest-free parts instead of paying the total bill at once (Source:


[Gulf News](https://gulfnews.com/business/most-uae-consumers-use-at-least-one-emerging-payment-method-mastercard-1.89665983) ). When these shoppers land on an Indian website that only presents standard card fields, hesitation sets in, leading to smaller order values and abandoned carts.


To solve this gap, Razorpay has integrated Tabby into its cross-border payments setup.


Tabby is the largest BNPL player in the Middle East region and the highest-valued fintech in the region at $6.5 billion, with over 25 million registered users and 70,000 businesses (Source:


[The Fintech Times)](https://thefintechtimes.com/tabby-secures-233-million-at-6-5-billion-valuation-to-accelerate-regional-financial-services-expansion/) .


With this integration, eligible shoppers in the UAE can select Tabby directly on an Indian brand’s checkout and split their purchase into 4 interest-free payments. The shopper completes verification smoothly inside Tabby’s flow, while the Indian business receives settlements natively without changing its domestic operational workflow.


## Simple Operations Without Overseas Setup


Historically, offering regional payment preferences in the Gulf required heavy legal and financial overhead. An Indian business had to incorporate a local corporate subsidiary in the UAE, open foreign commercial bank accounts, and handle complicated foreign exchange reconciliations.


Integrating Tabby via Razorpay removes that friction entirely. Indian exporters gain direct access to regional consumer preferences while keeping their corporate footprint anchored at home:


- **No overseas incorporation:** Indian brands do not need to register a legal company, secure a local trade license, or open bank accounts in the UAE. Operations remain entirely managed from India.


- **Direct settlements:** Export sales processed through Tabby settle straight into existing Indian bank accounts through Razorpay.


- **Higher buyer confidence:** International customers complete orders through a familiar, trusted interface, which helps reduce hesitation and cart abandonment at the final payment step.


## Technical Integration and Developer Setup


Getting Tabby up and running requires minimal effort, whether you run an off-the-shelf store or a custom-built website:


- **Shopify stores:** Tabby works out of the box with zero code. All order and customer details sync automatically through your existing Razorpay setup.


- **Custom websites:** Your team can activate Tabby using the standard Razorpay integration. Passing along clear product and customer details ensures fast order approvals and a seamless checkout experience.


## Availability and Dashboard Access


For Indian exporters already approved for international payments on Razorpay and actively selling to customers in the UAE, Tabby is automatically turned on. No manual onboarding forms or separate contracts are required.


For detailed technical specifications, payload guidelines, and integration examples, visit


[razorpay.com/docs/payments/payment-methods/tabby](http://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payment-methods/tabby) .


If Tabby hasn’t been automatically enabled on your checkout yet, you can request access using the link below, and our team will follow up shortly.


[Apply for Tabby](https://razorpay.typeform.com/to/QFp9A868)
